arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-plcodex-hygiene.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git clone --quiet --depth 3 --branch main https://github.com/martaxi-boss/Project-leader-codex.git "$tmp/repo"
cd "$tmp/repo"
echo PREFLIGHT_START
printf 'USER='; id -un
printf 'OS='; uname -s
printf 'PYTHON='; python3 --version
printf 'HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'BASE='; git remote get-url origin
printf 'STATUS='; git status --porcelain | wc -l
echo PREFLIGHT_END
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,collections,re,json,os
p=subprocess.run(['git','ls-files','-z'],capture_output=True,check=True).stdout.decode().split('\0')
files=[Path(x) for x in p if x]
print('TRACKED_FILES',len(files))
print('TRACKED_BYTES',sum(x.stat().st_size for x in files if x.exists()))
print('TOP_SIZE',[(str(x),x.stat().st_size) for x in sorted(files,key=lambda f:f.stat().st_size if f.exists() else 0,reverse=True)[:12]])
print('TOP_LEVEL',collections.Counter(str(x).split('/')[0] for x in files).most_common(12))
junk=[str(x) for x in files if re.search(r'(?i)(^|/)(\.DS_Store|__pycache__|\.pytest_cache|node_modules|dist|build|\.venv|backup|old)(/|$)|\.(bak|tmp|orig|rej|pyc|swp)$',str(x))]
print('TRACKED_JUNK_CANDIDATES',junk[:60],len(junk))
print('GITHUB_WORKFLOWS',[str(x) for x in files if x.parts[:2]==('.github','workflows')])
print('LEGACY_INGRESS_REFERENCES')
for name in files:
 if name.suffix not in ('.py','.md','.json','.toml','.yml','.yaml','.sh') or str(name).startswith('.project-leader/'):continue
 if name.stat().st_size>150000:continue
 for line_no,line in enumerate(name.read_text(errors='replace').splitlines(),1):
  if any(term in line.lower() for term in ('owner_coordinator_ingress','independent vps coordinator','vps issue','codex/owner_coordinator_ingress.py')):
   print('REF',str(name),line_no,line[:185])
print('UNUSED_IMPORTS_NOT_ASSERTED')
# Display only filenames matching obvious secret-misconfiguration; never print values.
suspicious=[str(x) for x in files if x.name in ('.env','.env.production','id_rsa','id_ed25519') or re.search(r'(?i)\.(pem|p12|pfx|key)$',x.name)]
print('SENSITIVE_FILENAMES',suspicious[:35],len(suspicious))
print('COORDINATOR_CONFIG_PRESENT',[(x,Path(x).exists()) for x in ['AGENTS.md','CODEX_COORDINATION.md','.codex/config.toml','codex/smart.py','codex/agent_policy.py','codex/cloud_bridge.py']])
PY
git diff --check HEAD^ HEAD
echo SOURCE_DIFF_CHECK_PASS
python3 -m unittest discover -s codex/tests -p 'test_*.py' -q 2>&1 | tail -n 20
echo CODEX_UNIT_SUITE_PASS
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' -q 2>&1 | tail -n 20
echo CONTROL_UNIT_SUITE_PASS
echo REPORT_END
